topic: What minimum audit evidence should accompany a multi-agent recommendation so a reviewer can reproduce it?

transcript.content: Hey team, to make any multi-agent decision reproducible, we have to record the query, timestamp, source database, and row count before issuing a recommendation. Two of our three cached sources require explicit audit retention, so the evidence bundle must outlive the session. @CloudArchitect, how are we anchoring this cryptographically?
